big_case.notes: The question presented (whether Greenough/Pettus bar common-fund service awards to class representatives) is a real, acknowledged 5-1 circuit split touching most class settlements, with Chamber amicus support; but the vehicle was a $5,000 award affirmed by unpublished summary order, the Court had declined the same question repeatedly, it denied without relist or noted writing, and public salience is low.
